name: Void Whale
description: From about year 5 a single huge scarred beast, the Leviathan, roams in from the galaxy edge. It hunts down and swallows lightly defended stations (mining, research and small bases), then hyper-lunges away to a quiet system to digest. Its wounds persist and heal only slowly: hurt it repeatedly and it flees into deep space, then returns for the empire that hurt it most. Whoever lands the killing blow earns a big bounty, the goodwill of every other empire and a carcass salvage field.
